DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney

The CT scan confirms the presence of multiple cysts in the collecting ducts of the medulla, which is the hallmark radiographic finding of Medullary Sponge Kidney. Given your history of recurrent urinary tract infections, visible hematuria, and right flank pain, this structural abnormality explains your symptoms as the cysts likely predispose you to stone formation and infection.
